item.text: The exporter stops when a page contains fewer records than requested, but the gateway filters deleted records after paging. That makes a short—or empty—page possible even when more records remain. I’ll make it follow the gateway’s cursor until it returns `null`. Project exports use a larger page size, which masks this issue in the reported example.

item.text:
Fixed CAT-284. The exporter now follows pagination cursors until `null`, so deleted records no longer cause early termination. The reported example exports both `i-1` and `i-3`.

Added regression coverage for short pages, entirely deleted pages, and empty cursor tokens. Project page sizing is unchanged.

All 5 tests pass; `git diff --check` passes.
